checks: 2026-11-05: temporary git repositories for merge3 and rebind-groupant; mutation controls (delete-vs-change ignored, identity map, no rehash, joined duplicates) each turned a test red.
cost: Linear in value size plus bounded O(n*m) LCS tables (40M cells); three git show per merged file; one ls-files scan per rebound source.
description: Three-way JSON merge inside a git merge with keyed arrays and diff3 sequences, source-binding refresh and groupant byte-range rebinding through a line diff.
forward: Clean merges apply one-side or disjoint changes; conflicts are reported (exit 3) and nothing is written; both-sides sha256 changes of a bound path are recomputed from the working tree; rebind refreshes only listed paths; rebind-groupant maps byte ranges and reports TEXT CHANGED.
inverse: Typed behavior complement first and nonunique reverse reconstruction second; see model.md.

Excluded: written files with conflicts, joined insertions that repeat an element, silent refresh of unlisted bindings, revision fields rebound; a clean merge output does not identify its inputs without git history.
limitations: Intra-line edits map to block boundaries; criss-cross merges use the single merge base git reports.
state: Base/HEAD/MERGE_HEAD values via git show, working-tree files, sidecar manifests and tracked group manifests.
